name: Pipecat
description: Voice sessions of the assistant on Pipecat, and subtitles transcribed from videos' audio: turns detected by Silero VAD and Smart Turn, recognized and spoken by local models (Whisper on speaches, Kokoro) or cloud services (OpenAI-compatible, Deepgram, Cartesia, ElevenLabs).
author: Mavio

tasks.name: Download models
tasks.description: Downloads the local models the recognizers, voices and transcribers use

containers.name: whisper
containers.description: speaches, running the Whisper models of the recognizers and transcribers of the Whisper service, on an NVIDIA GPU when the container engine gives one
